offers.description: Fixed price per vehicle for up to 4 passengers departing 07:00–22:00.

mainEntity.name: Why is Salzburg more expensive than Kitzbühel when it is closer?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is a shorter drive but a longer day for the car — Salzburg pick-ups and drop-offs are concentrated in the city centre, where access and waiting take longer than a chalet door. The rate reflects the round trip, not just the kilometres.

mainEntity.name: Can you continue on to Zell am See or Saalbach?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — those are separate routes and we price them individually. Choose "Other destination" in the calculator and tell us where, and we will come back with a fixed figure.

mainEntity.name: Is the old town accessible by car?

acceptedAnswer.text: Partly. Much of the centre is pedestrianised and some hotels are only reachable on foot from a nearby drop-off point. We know which ones, and we will tell you before the day rather than on arrival.

mainEntity.name: Does the route cross a border?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, Germany into Austria at Walserberg. It is a Schengen crossing with no routine checks, though occasional spot controls happen. Bring your passport or ID card.
